'''Klesk''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] master of the [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he had set up a [[Blackscale camp|camp]] in the southern part of the [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] with a group of his slavers. The rival Trandoshan [[Zssik Clan/Legends|Zssik Clan]] planned to destroy the Blackscale's slavery operations on Kashyyyk by letting the Wookiee resistance destroy the [[Avatar Orbital Platform|Avatar Platform]]. To achieve this, the Trandoshan [[Mosolium]] paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to travel to the slaver's camp and kill Klesk in order to acquire his access codes to the space station.
